He has cosponsored the Richard L. Trumka Protecting the Right to Organize Act (PRO Act) of 2023, a vital piece of legislation that fortifies labor protections. The PRO Act enables employees to more freely organize and collectively bargain, ensuring that the voice of labor is heard loud and clear. Committed to gender equality, Congressman Thanedar also supports the Paycheck Fairness Act. This bill aims to close the gender wage gap by providing stronger remedies for wage discrimination based on sex, including considerations like pregnancy and sexual orientation. Recognizing that a livable wage is a human right, the Congressman has cosponsored the Raise the Wage Act, which aims to increase the minimum wage to $17 per hour. This bold move is a step towards ensuring that all Americans can earn a wage that meets the basic cost of living. Latest October 17, 2023 Rep. Recognizing the unique challenges that veterans face, he has co-sponsored a range of legislation aimed at improving the quality of life for our military personnel, both active and retired. For example, he co-sponsored the Veteran Entrepreneurship Training Act of 2023, which enhances the Boots to Business Program administered by the Small Business Administration. This program provides vital entrepreneurship training to individuals, including veterans and active members of the Armed Forces, setting them on a path to financial stability and success after their service. Beyond the transition to civilian life, Congressman Thanedar is also focused on the financial and health-related issues that veterans encounter. He supports the Major Richard Star Act, which allows combat-disabled uniformed services retirees with fewer than 20 years of service to concurrently receive veterans' disability compensation and retired pay without reduction. He introduced the Stopping Abusive Student Loan Collection Practices in Bankruptcy Act, which provides for the granting of attorney's fees and the costs of the proceeding to debtors whose student loans are discharged due to undue hardship, thereby offering a financial lifeline to those grappling with educational debt. Following this, Congressman Thanedar has also concentrated on improving the quality of education and teacher support through co-sponsoring the American Teacher Act. This legislation aims to elevate the teaching profession by increasing minimum salaries for public school teachers and initiating a national campaign about the value of educators. Additionally, he co-sponsored the Charter Oversight, Accountability, and Transparency Act or COAT Act to tackle oversight issues with charter schools, particularly pressing in Michigan. To ensure a more sustainable future and academic enrichment for students, he supports the Green New Deal for Public Schools, offering a pathway to environmental responsibility and additional tutoring programs in schools. He has cosponsored the SUPPORT for SNAP Act, which aims to enhance nutrition assistance for individuals experiencing homelessness. Additionally, he backs the Universal School Meals Program Act of 2023. This legislation would make school breakfasts and lunches free for all children, taking a crucial step to eliminate child hunger and help students focus on their education. Recognizing that food insecurity also affects college students, Congressman Thanedar supports the Opportunity To Address College Hunger Act. This bill requires colleges with work-study programs to inform students that they may be eligible for SNAP benefits, bridging the gap between students and essential food assistance programs. He also cosponsored the WIC for Kids Act, an act that helps make it easier to connect kids with SNAP, TANF, and Medicaid during times of hardship Latest July 27, 2023 Rep. Recognizing that healthcare is a fundamental human right, he has co-sponsored the Medicare for All Act. This comprehensive bill aims to establish a national health insurance program that would extend coverage to all U.S. residents, thereby breaking down one of the most significant barriers to healthcare access. In addition to championing universal healthcare, Congressman Thanedar supports a range of measures aimed at addressing health disparities and specific healthcare needs. He co-sponsored the Women’s Health Protection Act of 2023 to safeguard women’s autonomy and access to abortion services without government interference. Further, acknowledging the urgent crisis of maternal mortality and morbidity in the U.S., particularly among Black women, he has backed the Black Maternal Health Momnibus Act. This legislation seeks to eliminate preventable maternal deaths and disparities. Having witnessed the impacts of environmental degradation on marginalized communities, he takes a multifaceted approach to environmental policy. To this end, he has co-sponsored the Green New Deal, a comprehensive legislation aiming for sweeping greenhouse gas reductions, high-wage union jobs, and social justice within a 10-year national mobilization effort. This bill encompasses everything from building smarter power grids to reducing pollution and ensuring equitable access to essential services. Building on this holistic vision, Congressman Thanedar has also backed other key environmental bills. He co-sponsored the Energy Resilient Communities Act, a forward-thinking bill that aims to make critical energy infrastructure more resilient to the hazards of climate change, providing grants for the development of clean energy microgrids. He has introduced the PHD First Act, which seeks to grant lawful permanent resident status and authorized dual intent to certain doctoral degree holders, emphasizing the need for skilled individuals in the country. Additionally, he is a cosponsor of the U.S. Citizenship Act, offering an earned path to citizenship while addressing the root causes of migration and managing the southern border responsibly. To improve detention conditions, Congressman Thanedar also supports the Dignity for Detained Immigrants Act, which sets humane standards for facilities housing detained immigrants. He is also a strong advocate for the Eliminating Backlogs Act of 2023. This bill aims to increase the number of employment-based immigration visas, thus speeding up the legal immigration process for skilled workers. Latest August 16, 2023 Rep. He has co-sponsored impactful legislation like the Commission to Study and Develop Reparation Proposals for African Americans Act and H.Res.414, which not only calls for the United States to acknowledge its moral and legal obligation to provide reparations for the enslavement of Africans but also specifies a $14 trillion plan to rectify these longstanding injustices. Additionally, Congressman Thanedar champions the Freedom to Vote Act as a crucial step toward equity. This legislation is especially relevant to marginalized communities, as it aims to improve ballot access, end partisan gerrymandering, and limit the influence of dark money, thereby making the political process more accessible and equitable. In rounding out his comprehensive approach to civil rights, Congressman Thanedar has co-sponsored the Equality Act. This important bill aims to extend the scope of the Civil Rights Act of 1964 to include protections against discrimination based on sex, sexual orientation, or gender identity.
